message.reasoning: The user wants to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They want to start Docker container? Actually "start Docker on window using docker start" might mean start Docker service? But docker start is used to start containers, not Docker service. To start Docker service, we use net start com.docker.service or docker-machine start default. But the user says "start Docker on window using docker start." Might be ambiguous. They might want to start Docker Desktop service. We can use net start com.docker.service. But they specifically mention docker start. That command starts a container. So maybe they want to start a container named "Docker"? That doesn't make sense. They might want to start Docker Desktop. So we can use net start com.docker.service. Let's ask clarifying question.
